first_reading.quote: The hour hand (shortest, thicker) points toward the 6-7 region. The minute hand (longer) points toward the 6-7 region too. The third hand (the long thin one pointing to the upper left near the 9-10 area, specifically around the 47-minute mark) is the second hand? Wait, let me look.

note: 首次说时针和分针均在6–7附近且尚未分清第三手；最终认定分针在47分、时针近7，秒为00。
